bibl.title: A Song-Sharing Service? Hymns, Scribal Agency, and "Religion" in Two Late Antique Papyri.
bibl.seg: Arkadiy Avdokhin, A Song-Sharing Service? Hymns, Scribal Agency, and "Religion" in Two Late Antique Papyri.
Mattias Brand & Eline Scheerlinck (edd.), Religious Identifications in Late Antique Papyri: 3rd-12th Century Egypt (London - New York, 2023) pp. 45-68.
bibl.note: Introduction. - From communities and "religions" to individual agency. - P. Berol. Inv. 9794 (= van Haelst 722; LDAB 5201): a hymn between "religions" and scribal agency. - P. Paris Louvre Inv. N. 2391 (= van Haelst 1075; LDAB 5738): archaizing paideia or religious plurality?. - Final thoughts: the individual agency of late antique song-sharing.
